verdict.rationale: AI Gateway exposes a documented OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint, a Universal endpoint for multiple providers, a REST API for configuration (rate limits, fallbacks, dynamic routing), and a public OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe. Headers like cf-aig-step, cf-aig-cache-status, and methods like patchLog show programmatic control beyond the dashboard. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of API robustness, and a unified single-page API reference (docs are scattered across feature pages).
